mapper.select: SELECT fs.CORP_GR AS corpGr , fs.TR_YMD AS trYmd , fs.TR_CD AS trCd , fs.FUND_CD AS fundCd , fs.JM_CD AS jmCd , F_JM_NM (fs.corp_gr, fs.jm_cd) AS jmNm , fs.KOSCOM_CD AS koscomCd , fs.HWAKJ_AEK AS hwakjAek , fs.SURY_AEK AS suryAek , fs.DANGA AS danga , fs.CHUI_AEK AS chuiAek , fs.TAX AS tax , ia.FUND_NM AS xxFundCd , ia.FUND_NM AS fundNm , ia.mg_cd AS xxMgCd , ia.mg_cd AS mgCd , fs.SUSU AS susu , fs.TYPE_TRENCH AS typeTrench , fs.BS_TYPE AS bsType , fs.BROK_YMD AS brokYmd , 0 AS jangoJusu , 0 AS xxBoyuJusu , 1 AS pVisible FROM SJT0FS fs , SZM0IA ia WHERE fs.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND fs.tr_ymd = #{ymd} AND fs.jm_cd LIKE #{jmCd} AND fs.tr_cd = #{trCd} AND ia.CORP_GR = fs.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = fs.FUND_CD ORDER BY fs.fund_cd ASC
